_meta.description: Engine-independent TTS pronunciation dictionary for JARVIS. Rewrites English/Latin-script terms and loanwords embedded in Hindi speech to a Devanagari spelling that any TTS engine's phonemizer renders correctly, with natural Hindi cadence and zero voice switching mid-sentence.
_meta.applies_to: Substituted when the surrounding utterance or segment is classified as Hindi ('hi'). Preprocessed before segmentation so multi-word loanwords remain unified under the Hindi voice.

schema.term: Canonical English/Latin-script spelling as it appears in LLM output, tool names, or speech
schema.devanagari: Devanagari spelling that phonemizes correctly through a Hindi TTS voice
